verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media relay server, and a natural-language operating interface is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a conventional CLI (moq-cli), SDK libraries, and an llms.txt docs index. None of these is a documented way to operate the relay through natural-language commands; llms.txt is documentation for LLMs and at most an adjacent building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
